column2: You truly are certain this is what you want...?
Let me stress it once more: that course means...
that you will become the new god!?
Then, to recover your former $$記憶$$...
If you intend to settle this with your own hands...
“Now that it has been decided, there is nothing to be done!”
“At this festival, the one chosen as Lord $$サタン$$'s $$生けにえ$$...”
“...was not you, but your younger brother...”
“...said that this time, I would be chosen...”
“You said it would be all right...!”
“To be chosen as the $$生けにえ$$ for that rite...”
“If you manage to survive the rite...
“Of all people, he was chosen as the $$生けにえ$$!?”
Did that lightning make you remember something...?
It seems you remembered something, after all?
A-are you all right, $$お兄ちゃん$$!?
I-I only just now... My head, too...!
